title: Completion commutes with the finite polynomial quotient used in the degree-p step
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $p\geq1$ be an integer, $f\in R$, and $C=R[z]/(z^p-f)$, the quotient of the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] by the ideal generated by $z^p-f$. Assume $C$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$, and let $C^\wedge=\varprojlim_nC/\mathfrak n^n$ be its $\mathfrak n$-adic completion. Then there is an isomorphism of rings $C^\wedge\cong R^\wedge[z]/(z^p-f)$ compatible with the maps from $R[z]$ to both sides (induced by $R\to R^\wedge$ and $z\mapsto z$).
